headline.statement: Of the 8 areas (of 80, ~25 km) EMBER flagged each week in 2025, 57.6% saw at least one newly reported wildfire within 7 days.
headline.test_period: 2025 (51 Monday-issued weeks), labels from the NIFC WFIGS live feed; model frozen since training on 2015-2020
headline.verdict: no measurable advantage established (95% CI includes zero)
caveats: 2025 was previously used once for this frozen model (top-10% capture pre-registered as primary); the alert hit rate is a secondary measure of that same frozen test
~25 km areas, one-week horizon, reported fires only (records miss fires), no exact ignition location or time
random 8-of-80 selection would be right about 19% of the time in 2025 (base rate)

overnight_candidate.model: E0+redflag (Red Flag Warnings / Fire Weather Watches)

original_2023_2024_holdout.note: used holdout; unchanged since first scoring

live_forecast.score_after: After about two weeks (late reports settle): python3 -m forecasting.fetch_wfigs --refresh && python3 -m forecasting.predict --date 2026-10-19 --score-outcomes
